twist.underdog.desc: The last team in the standings gets 1.5 times the points.

round.music.desc: Play a fragment: who sings it, or what is it called?
round.introSprint.desc: The intro grows: 1, 2, 4, then 8 seconds. Guess early for more points.
round.rewind.desc: The song plays backwards. Which one is it?
round.soundCheck.desc: An animal, a machine, a noise from daily life. What makes it?
round.lyricGap.desc: One word of a song line is gone. Fill it in.
round.pixelFog.desc: Big blocks that slowly get sharp. The sooner you know, the more you score.
round.silhouette.desc: Only the outline is shown. Who or what is it?
round.oddOneOut.desc: Three or four pictures. Which one does not belong?
round.emoji.desc: A film, song or saying told in emoji.
round.orderUp.desc: Put the items in order: oldest first, smallest first, and so on.
round.pairUp.desc: Match every item on the left with one on the right.
round.mapDrop.desc: Tap the spot on a map or picture. The closest pin wins.
scoring.own.mapDrop: The closest pin gets the points; spot on (within 2%) doubles them.

builder.f.spotName: Name of the place (shown at the reveal)
builder.f.spotHint: Click on the picture where the right answer is.
round.buzzer.desc: The first team to buzz answers out loud. Wrong? The others may buzz.
round.lastStanding.desc: One wrong answer and your team is out for the rest of the round.
round.pushYourLuck.desc: Every right answer doubles your pot. Bank it, or risk it all on the next question.
round.steal.desc: A right answer scores and takes the same points from the team in first place.
round.pickYourLevel.desc: See the topic, choose easy, medium or hard, and get your own question.
round.hotStreak.desc: Right answers in a row count up: 1x, 2x, 3x the points.
round.listRush.desc: Type as many items of the list as you can before time runs out.
round.crowdMind.desc: No right answer: score by giving the answer most teams give.
scoring.own.lastStanding: Every question you survive scores; a miss puts you out of the round.
scoring.own.pushYourLuck: The pot doubles with every right answer; only banked points count.
scoring.own.steal: Right = + points, taken from the leader.
scoring.own.hotStreak: 1x, 2x, 3x ... the points for right answers in a row.
scoring.own.listRush: The points for every right item.
scoring.own.crowdMind: The most common answer scores (at least two teams).
play.buzzMine: You were first! Say your answer out loud.
play.pickLevel: Pick a level before you see the question
play.bankConfirm: Keep {n} points and sit out the rest of this round?
play.bankedWait: Your points are safe. Watch the others sweat.
play.outOfRound: Out for this round. Next round you are back!
screen.ownLevel: Every team answers its own question
screen.answerOnPhone: The question is on your phone
screen.buzzNow: Buzz on your phone when you know it!
screen.listGo: Type as many as you can: {n} to find
screen.levelHint: Easy, medium or hard: choose on your phone
builder.f.listItemsHint: One per line. Other spellings after a slash: Brussels / Brussel
round.drawGuess.desc: Every team draws the same thing on its phone. Then everyone votes for the best drawing.
round.captionThis.desc: Write the funniest caption for the picture. Then vote for the best one.
round.bluffBank.desc: Make up a believable answer, then find the real one between the bluffs.
round.actItOut.desc: One team acts out a secret without words. The others type what it is.
round.photoHunt.desc: Take a photo for the task with your phone. Then vote for the best one.
round.whosWho.desc: Every team answers a question about itself. Then guess which team wrote what.
scoring.own.drawGuess: Every vote for your drawing is worth the points.
scoring.own.captionThis: Every vote for your caption is worth the points.
scoring.own.bluffBank: Find the truth = points; every team fooled by your bluff = points.
scoring.own.actItOut: A right guess = points; the actors score when anyone gets it.
scoring.own.photoHunt: Every vote for your photo is worth the points.
scoring.own.whosWho: Every right match is worth the points.
play.voted: Vote cast! Look at the big screen.
play.typeAboutUs: Your answer (the others will guess it was you)
play.photoFailed: That photo did not work. Try again.
play.actHint: Keep your phone hidden from the other teams.
screen.bluffNow: Make up a believable answer on your phone
screen.guessAct: Type what you think it is
screen.photoNow: Take the photo with your phone!
screen.findTruth: Which one is true? Vote on your phone
screen.matchTeams: Who wrote what? Match on your phone
screen.voteBest: Vote for the best on your phone
round.stakeIt.desc: See only the category, bet your points, then answer. Right wins the bet, wrong loses it.
round.localLegend.desc: Your own questions about the town, the club or the pub, with your own picture or logo.
round.clueLadder.desc: Who or what is it? The clues go from very hard to easy. The sooner you know, the more points.
round.fiveFacts.desc: One open question with five keywords. Every keyword you find scores.
round.clipRecall.desc: Watch a short video, then type every detail you remember.
round.opponentsPick.desc: The leading team picks the category for all the other teams, and sits that question out.
round.headToHead.desc: Finale: the top two teams race for the answer. The other teams predict who wins.
round.clockBank.desc: Every team starts with 60 seconds. Your clock only runs on your turn; a right answer wins seconds. At zero you are out.
round.clockDuel.desc: Finale: the top two take turns. Your clock runs until you answer right. The first clock at zero loses.
scoring.own.stakeIt: Right = + your bet, wrong or no answer = - your bet.
scoring.own.fiveFacts: A point per keyword; all five = double.
scoring.own.headToHead: The fastest right finalist scores; so does every team that predicted it.
scoring.own.clockBank: A right answer = the points plus the seconds on your clock.
scoring.own.clockDuel: The team that still has time when the other runs out wins the points.
twist.mysteryCategory.desc: The round title stays hidden until the last answer. Give the round a title!
twist.suddenDeath.desc: A team's first mistake ends the round for that team.
twist.shrinkingOptions.desc: Every 5 seconds a wrong answer disappears, and the points drop with it.
twist.lifeline.desc: Once per round every team may take away two wrong answers on its phone.
twist.silentRound.desc: No sounds and no countdown digits: only the light tells you time is running.

cloud.title: My quiz folder
cloud.intro: Keep your quizzes in a folder in OneDrive or Google Drive. Build a quiz at home, and the quiz laptop picks it up by itself (and the other way round). Pictures, sounds and clips go along. Export and import keep working too.
cloud.none: No quiz folder linked yet. Your quizzes stay on this computer only.
cloud.disconnectSure: Unlink the quiz folder? Your quizzes stay on this computer and in the folder, they just stop syncing.
cloud.how: Pick the same folder on every computer that runs Quizbrew. It syncs at start, every minute and right after you save. A quiz you delete, or the older one when both computers changed it, waits 30 days in the _trash folder.
cloud.notFound: That folder cannot be found. Is OneDrive or Google Drive running on this computer?
cloud.missing: The library folder inside your quiz folder is gone, so nothing was deleted. Check the folder and sync again.
cloud.absolute: Type the full path of the folder, for example C:\Users\you\OneDrive\Quizbrew.
cloud.inside: Pick a folder outside Quizbrew's own folder.
cloud.typeIt: The folder window did not open. Type the path of the folder instead.
